book_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed nightstand_b1 (09:22), but it was at coffee_table_l1. During the day, it is anchored to the living room. Late at night (22:04), it moves to bed_b1. Check coffee_table_l1 for daytime queries; switch to bed_b1 only for late-night queries. Do not assume bedroom spots during the day.

tablet_yuki: Similar to the book. During the day (17:00), it is at coffee_table_l1, not nightstand_b1. Late at night (22:40), it moves to bed_b1. Check coffee_table_l1 for daytime queries; switch to bed_b1 for late-night queries.

charger_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed desk_b1 (09:14), but it was at coffee_table_l1. It remains anchored to the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 first; do not assume it moves to the bedroom or desk.

water_bottle_yuki: Volatile. Previously assumed desk_b1 or dish_rack_k1, but found at coffee_table_l1 (10:08) and kitchen_table_k1 (19:32) on day 18. It clusters around living and kitchen surfaces, not the workspace or dish rack. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning/afternoon; check kitchen_table_k1 for evening. Do not assume desk_b1 or dish_rack_k1.

mug_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed desk_b1, but found at coffee_table_l1 (12:25) on day 16. It is not in kitchen storage or the desk during the day. Check coffee_table_l1; do not assume cupboard_k1 or desk_b1.

glass_yuki: Volatile. Found at kitchen_table_k1 (19:43) and cupboard_k1 (22:59) on day 16. It moves between kitchen surfaces and storage. Check cupboard_k1 and kitchen_table_k1, prioritizing the most recent confirmed location. Do not assume sink_k1.

General Pattern: Yuki’s items (book, tablet, charger, water bottle, mug) are overwhelmingly at coffee_table_l1 during the day. However, book and tablet specifically move to bed_b1 late at night. Water bottle shifts to kitchen_table_k1 in the evening. Stop assuming desk_b1, side_table_l1, or dish_rack_k1 for daytime items. For late-night queries, check bed_b1 for book and tablet, but keep charger at coffee_table_l1.
